_how_to_add: One object per client in "companies": { "name": "…", "sector": "…" }. Publish a name only where the client has agreed to appear on the site — the band stays hidden while this list is empty, and nothing here is invented. The sector is one short word (Events, Church, Retail, School, Corporate) and is optional. Names are written in block letters because the studio's owner set the wall that way; a new name goes in the same case.
